Select IC50 activity rows for human SRC kinase (CHEMBL267). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, join docs on doc_id, and join compound_records on record_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL267 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
